config.label: API key for gated tools (fairseal_entropy, fairseal_stats, fairseal_rng_generate, fairseal_notarize_decision, fairseal_anchor_submit)
config.description: API key for gated tools (fairseal_entropy, fairseal_stats, fairseal_rng_generate, fairseal_notarize_decision, fairseal_anchor_submit). Key prefix: fsn_. Without a key these tools return 401; free tools (game reads, notarize_status, anchor_status) work without any key. x402 micropayment ($0.02 USDC on Base) is an alternative to the key for notarize/anchor.

config.description: Key override for the notary service only (POST /v1/notarize). Falls back to FAIRSEAL_API_KEY if not set. Key prefix: fsn_.
